cues.en: A good effort. Oh, well, decidedly that.
An excellent effort. You have shown us something
cues.zh: 非常出色的努力。你今晚给我们展示了

cues.en: It is, isn't it, sire? Yes. Indeed. So then you liked it. You you really liked it, sire. Well, of course, I did. It's very good.
cues.zh: 确实如此，对吧，陛下？是的。确实。那么你喜欢它。你真的很喜欢它，陛下。嗯，当然，我喜欢。非常好。

cues.en: Of course, now and then... Just just just now, man. It
cues.zh: 当然，偶尔……就刚才，伙计。它

cues.en: Too many notes, your majesty. Exactly. Very well put. Too many notes.
cues.zh: 音符太多了，陛下。没错，说得太好了。音符实在太多了。

cues.en: There are just as many notes, majesty, as are required, neither more nor less. Well, my dear fellow, there are in fact only so many notes the ear can hear in the course of an evening.
cues.zh: 陛下，音符刚好是所需的数量，不多也不少。嗯，老兄，其实人在一个晚上能听进去的音符也就那么多。

cues.en: I I think I'm right in saying that. Aren't I, court composer?
cues.zh: 我……我想我没说错吧。是不是，宫廷作曲家？
大体上是这样？是的，陛下。

cues.en: My dear young man, don't take it too hard. Your work is ingenious.
cues.zh: 我亲爱的年轻人，别太往心里去。你的作品很有巧思。

cues.en: And there are simply too many notes. That's all. Just cut a few, and it'll be perfect.
cues.zh: 只是音符实在太多了。就这样。删掉几个，就完美了。

cues.en: Which few did you have in mind, majesty?
